AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-04-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for change of name of a minor this day.
Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V. Mack, CSR: Valerie Papale.
Petitioner, Vanessa Garcia Baltazar present in pro per for minor Estefany Cardenas Garcia, was sworn and examined.
The Court grants decree changing the minor's name to: Estefany Rivas Garcia.
Order signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-23-2003 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V.Mack, CSR: Leticia Perez.

Petitioner Vanessa Garcia Baltazar present for minor in pro per, was sworn and examined, (with Spanish interpreter, Christina Llop from ACCESS).

There being no proof of publication, the matter is ordered off calendar. Petitioner to file amended petition upon completion of publication. (Notice to biological father waived by Presiding Judge).
